title: GLIDER: General Laboratory Interface for Design, Experimentation, and Recording
description:
GLIDER is a cross-platform desktop application for laboratory automation. It combines visual flow programming for experimental protocols, direct hardware control over Arduino, Raspberry Pi and PC interfaces, multi-camera capture with pose tracking, frame-wise behavior classification, and timestamped synchronization with external acquisition systems such as fiber photometry.

This release (v1.0.0) is the version described in Bradham et al. (2026).
